{Dis(PlayerCharacter)} the victim of an armed robbery
"Stand and deliver!"

There have been increasing reports of crime on {PlayerSystem}, but you did not expect to get personally involved in an armed robbery. 

Briefly wondering if {fb(MinorHouse, "a minor house")} might have a hand in this, you join {fb(Protector, "your security detail")} in returning fire.
Victim of armed robbery
{PlayerCharacter} managed to survive an encounter with armed criminals
Bursts of gunfire pin you down

You are vastly outnumbered and in a terrible position but somehow manage to hold on. A few lucky shots here and there make the criminals hesitate, and as more of your security forces arrive they melt away.
Even if the crisis is eventually averted, you have paid for it with a nasty gunshot injury and {fb(Protector, "an agent")}'s life
Saved {PlayerCharacter}'s life
Even if you escaped the situation with a only a gunshot injury, you know that if it wasn't for {d(Protector)}'s protection, you'd likely be dead right now.
{PlayerCharacter}'s security team was killed in action
Die with your boots on
You quickly realize that you are not just outnumbered, but also outskilled. One by one, your security team dies attempting to prolong your existence.
You desperately try to surrender. The criminals are not having any of it and continue raining fire down at you.
{PlayerCharacter} was saved but {his(PlayerCharacter)} dog died
Eleventh hour reinforcements

As you prepare to meet your destiny, {HeadMilitary}'s forces charge in, obliterating your enemies in short order.

The reinforcements claim to have found you following a trail of blood. Your guard dog, despite being seriously wounded, managed to find help as a final act of loyalty. You are going to miss the animal.
{PlayerCharacter} was killed by armed criminals
No point asking who's to blame

There is a sharp pain, and to your horror a dark red stain rapidly spreads across your chest. Who let crime run so rampant? Why was your security so ineffective? Nothing matters now, everything is fading...

You feel the sharp pain, knowing what it must mean. Plenty of factors led to this situation, but pointing fingers now is of no use...

In your dying seconds, you hope your last stand is remembered as a heroic deed of {PlayerHouse}.
